text:
**Your guide**

The mental side is mine — the conditioning, the hypno, what sinks in and stays sunk. You keep the reins everywhere else. These answers set how far I may take your head.

prompt: How hard may I push at what you want?
hint: What you want is softer than it looks. This is how much room I take to reshape it.
choices: Lightly — nudge me toward what I already want
Expand me — pull me toward things adjacent to my wants
Any direction — within my hard limits, take my mind where you judge best

prompt: Should I show you my plans for your head?
hint: Conditioning works differently when you can see it coming — some sink deeper blind. Tell me which you are.
choices: Full transparency — tell me what you're doing
